text:
Alex: Quick idea — add a 5m 'lightning bug lane' at the end of weekly triage for tiny fixes/assignments?
Maria: +1. Helps clear churn. Maybe 10m on Thursdays so we don't rush.
Kevin: I can take the Thu slot this week but need to move triage 15m earlier (calendar clash).
Alex: Okay — what's the earliest folks can do? Current is 12:00. I prefer not earlier than 11:30.
Anya: I'm on calls until 11:50 most days. If we shift to 11:45 I can probably still make it but prefer 12:00.
Alex: Proposal: keep main triage at 12:00 Mon/Thu, add a 5m lightning lane at the end on Thu only. If Kevin needs Thu cover we rotate. Also add an async pre-read doc.
Maria: Sounds reasonable. Can you drop a tiny agenda snippet in the doc?
Alex: Pasting agenda snippet here:
```
- 5m quick status (top backlog / regressions)
- 10m owner assignments + quick blockers (3 items max)
- 5m lightning bug lane (assign & close tiny fixes)
- 5m rollups / action items
```
Kevin: I'll try to swap a call and update Thursday invite to 11:45 for this week only, then we can decide after. @Anya can you confirm if 11:45 is ok?
Anya: 11:45 is rough but doable this once. If we plan permanent change I prefer keep at 12.
Alex: Fair. Maria — can you create the async pre-read doc (one slide or a short list) and add a checklist owners can fill by Wed EOD? Link in thread when done.
Maria: Done — created https://redwood.internal/triage/weekly-pre-read (placeholder) and added a small checklist.
triage-bot: Reminder created: "weekly-triage-pre-read" by Maria. Next event Thu 11:45 -> 12:05 (temporary update).
Alex: Thanks. Final ask: owners, please drop 1–2 bullets in the doc by Wed EOD so we can triage faster.
Anya: Will add my items tonight.
Kevin: Updated invite for Thu this week. :thumbsup:
Alex: Great — we'll run the lightning lane pilot for two weeks and revisit.
Maria: +1, will add a tiny note to the rollup doc after the meeting.
Kevin: thanks everyone.
